cards.observation_text: Genetic markers track placental branches with plant-processing, digging, or flight specializations.
cards.inference_text: The lineage evidence favors mammals shaped by those specializations.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Pangolins form their own mammal order and are more closely related to carnivorans than to armadillos.
hints: The family tree passes near predators but leaves the cat branch behind.
The genetic sample is not from a true feline.
Shared ancestry does not mean a shared hunting lineage here.
Field team: look beyond the familiar big-paw branch.

cards.observation_text: The forelimbs retain compact digits for support, grasping, or digging.
cards.inference_text: The limb evidence favors candidates built for surfaces and soil.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Overlapping keratin scales protect most of its body when it curls into a ball.
hints: The forelimbs meet the ground instead of stretching into airfoils.
No flight membrane appears between the digits.
The body plan is built for climbing and digging, not lift.
Field team: keep this subject on a solid surface.

cards.observation_text: Movement centers on a stable home range, territory, tunnel system, or roost.
cards.inference_text: The route favors candidates that repeatedly use a familiar area.
cards.bonus_fact_text: It usually forages alone at night and can climb as well as dig.
hints: The tracks belong to one quiet traveler.
No broad line of hoofprints crosses the open ground.
Movement stays close to cover rather than roaming with a herd.
Field team: this route was made alone.

cards.observation_text: Feeding focuses on plants, fruit, termites, ants, or vertebrate prey.
cards.inference_text: The meal favors candidates with a concentrated food target.
cards.bonus_fact_text: A long sticky tongue collects ants and termites from nests opened by strong claws.
hints: The feeding marks focus on organized insect nests.
This diner does not sift broadly through beach sand.
Opened chambers suggest a narrow prey search.
Field team: follow the trail toward ants and termites.

cards.observation_text: Range records connect to arid Africa, coastal southern Africa, broader Asian forest, or oceanic islands.
cards.inference_text: The map evidence favors candidates centered in those regions.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Its range extends through parts of mainland and island Southeast Asia.
hints: The range tightens toward humid Southeast Asia.
The western edge stops short of a wider subcontinental sweep.
Island and peninsula forests matter more than open mainland breadth.
Field team: narrow the map toward the southeast.
